name: LiveKit Agents
description: Framework for realtime voice agents that join LiveKit rooms or phone calls, with example agents runnable from the terminal.
whatItDoes: Lets developers write agents that hold spoken conversations with users over WebRTC or SIP telephony. It covers turn detection, interruptions, tool use and hand-off between agents for production voice applications.
howItWorks: An agent program is written as a worker that connects to a LiveKit server and is dispatched into rooms. Plugins supply speech-to-text, language models and text-to-speech, or a realtime speech model. The same script runs in a local console mode, a development mode or a production mode, and tools can come from MCP servers.

requirements.name: LIVEKIT_URL
requirements.description: Address of a LiveKit server, cloud or self-hosted

requirements.name: LIVEKIT_API_KEY
requirements.description: Server API key, paired with LIVEKIT_API_SECRET

requirements.name: Model provider keys
requirements.description: Keys for the STT, LLM and TTS plugins installed

models: Pluggable providers such as OpenAI, Deepgram and Cartesia
